scope: Independent application queue ordering/lifetime review and supplied-buffer controls. No target execution or native scheduling equivalence.

relevant_contracts: Player callbacks generally arrive off main; client must synchronize player API use.
Do not stop player inside its completion callback.
dataPlayedBack is device rendering only; manual test uses dataRendered.
nil schedule time appends to previous scheduled command.

offline_audio.main_actor: blocked for entire background offline-engine run

controls: Atomic initial priming failure schedules zero buffers; empty source notifies once; queue cannot restart.
19 supplied buffers drain/refill in order while main actor blocked; duplicate callbacks do not double release/refill.
Synchronous scheduler callbacks are deferred; producer/scheduler nesting remains1 across100 buffers.
Cancel waits for active producer then prevents all subsequent scheduling; old callbacks ignored.
Refill error notifies once, stops production and retains outstanding buffers until cancel.
Cancel directly within terminal notification does not deadlock; old callbacks cannot affect fresh queue.
Zero-frame buffer rejected before any scheduling.
Actual offline AV player delivers >4-buffer PCM and then silence while main actor blocked.

retained_initial_failure.description: 7/8 tests passed. Physical-thread assertion included synchronous initial prime. DispatchQueue.sync may execute on caller thread; assertion was narrowed to post-prime refill/schedule/completion. Production scheduling behavior was not changed to satisfy this assertion.

source_review: Serial worker owns producer and pending buffers; UUID removal ignores duplicate/stale completion.
Completion callback only enqueues work, avoiding conversion or stop in AV callback.
Cancellation is a worker barrier before player stop/detach; queue-specific key permits cancellation within terminal notification.
Transport generation rejects old terminal notifications; engine start/prime failure stops current schedule.
open_limits: Refill worker is application host policy, not recovered Cubase thread topology.
No realtime deadline, device latency, DAC continuity or hardware underrun equivalence established.
Source remains fully resident; priming and seek preroll synchronously block caller pending readiness.

UI transport clock remains host-time based; a future actual producer underrun could diverge from delivered frames. Moving refill off main reduces one starvation cause but does not prove all underruns absent.
Device dataPlayedBack callback behavior is not exercised by manual dataRendered test.
Full application GUI and full suite acceptance are separate.
